column1: # The Tanzbär Lite's sound for each style, sent on style or key change and on Start (make_tanz.py -> TanzData.kt).
# Lengths in ms (to -40 dB; make_tanz.py finds the CC from measured.tsv), the rest as CC values 0..127.
# tune: which voices follow the key besides the kick (which always does): t tom, c conga, l clave, - none.
# ktune: the kick tune CC (3) with Kick tune: Style (Key tunes it to the key instead).
# bellmel: the cowbell's length (ms) when it plays a line; - for the usual 45 ms.
# Chosen by Claude from each style's design (fm1-build-status.md) and the measured lengths; to check by ear.
